findings.title: AFP reports hospital-confirmed three deaths, including a girl, from al-Mawasi displacement-camp strike
findings.publisher: Agence France-Presse (AFP), syndicated by Bangladesh Sangbad Sangstha (BSS)
findings.location: Al-Mawasi, west of Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: Displaced civilians in tent camp; three fatalities identified by Nasser Hospital as Hossam al-Zamli, Tamer Abu Sneima and seven-year-old Jouri al-Soufi; other wounded including a child and a woman. Earlier watch had recorded two fatalities including a girl in al-Mawasi. Reported 11 deaths and 50 injuries over 24 hours is an aggregate, not attributable entirely to this strike.
findings.supporting_passage: Nasser Hospital in the southern Gaza city of Khan Yunis confirmed the three deaths.
findings.source_type: Established wire reporting (AFP), attributed first-responder statement and named receiving hospital; syndicated report
findings.confidence: HIGH that AFP attributes three deaths to named hospital and civil defence; MEDIUM that this is a revised tally of the exact prior two-fatality report rather than a separate nearby incident

bounded_discovery_context.reporting_time_precision: Source date is 26 October; exact publication time not independently verified. The report might have been available before this hourly window; newly recalled during this check, not claimed to have occurred within the hour.
bounded_discovery_context.original_prior_record: Earlier watch recorded two deaths including a girl and 15 wounded in al-Mawasi; prior 07:51 heartbeat explicitly treated 25–26 October al-Mawasi fatalities as already known. This finding preserves only the incremental AFP/Nasser Hospital three-death identification and requires same-incident deduplication.
bounded_discovery_context.independent_confirmation: AFP quotes both Gaza civil defence and Nasser Hospital; Israeli military said it was looking into reports. No independent forensic verification claimed.
bounded_discovery_context.production_disposition: Supplementary handoff; editorial dedupe required. No authorization, approval, publication or schedule change.

findings.title: AP reports new UN Commission of Inquiry findings alleging sexual violence in six cases involving detainees from Gaza at Sde Teiman
findings.event_period: Since October 2023; dates of six alleged incidents not specified
findings.location: Sde Teiman military detention facility, Israel (outside Gaza); victims described as detainees from Gaza
findings.affected_population_or_system: Male Palestinian detainees from Gaza; UN-appointed independent Commission of Inquiry says it recently documented six cases involving alleged sexual violence by Israeli guards. AP says it could not independently corroborate several graphic allegations; Israel rejects accusations of sexual assault and challenges the commission.
findings.supporting_passage: documented six cases where Israeli guards were sexually violent toward male detainees from Gaza
findings.source_type: Established wire reporting on a newly released UN-mandated Commission of Inquiry report; original report URL not independently retrieved
findings.confidence: MEDIUM for the newly reported Commission findings as accurately attributed by AP; allegations are not independently verified and the individual event dates are unknown

bounded_discovery_context.publication_precision: AP says report released Monday 26 October; exact hour is unknown. Newly discovered during watch, not asserted to have been published after prior 07:51 completion.
bounded_discovery_context.geography_scope: Gaza-origin detainees, but alleged acts were at a detention facility outside Gaza. Flag for strict production geography gate; not suitable for an in-Gaza at-a-glance item without policy-compliant development.
bounded_discovery_context.recycled_elements_excluded: AP's figure of 196 deaths near the Yellow Line during the ceasefire and territorial-control context were reported by UN months before Oct 26 and are not counted as new.
bounded_discovery_context.limitations: UN primary report was not found among bounded searches; AP says it could not independently corroborate several sexual assault accounts; reported as allegations, not adjudicated facts.
